title: o_e, u_e, e_e (VCe with o, u, e)
goal: Complete the VCe set — read and spell words with o_e (/ō/), u_e (/o͞o/ or /ū/), and e_e (rare, /ē/).
newToday: o_e (home, rope), u_e — two sounds: /o͞o/ (rule, June) and /ū/ (cute, mule); e_e (these, Steve — rare, flag it)

A.text: Steve moved to a home. / It is big, and it has a gate. / Steve rode his bike home and did a jig. / He is very glad. / At home, Steve has a cute pet mule named Duke. / Duke likes a plate of grass. / "This home is very fine," said Steve, and he made a note to tell his pal.

B.text: Steve got home very late from his shift. / His job is to help sick kids, and the shift ran long. / At home, he made a snack and sat next to the stove. / His wife left a note: "I made a plate for you." / Steve smiled. / It was a very long shift, but home felt like a rest at last.
